prose: Railway's incident report says the October hack exploited a previously unknown build-infrastructure vulnerability to escape filesystem isolation and steal an internal credential, then customer authentication secrets, generating about $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage. Decrypted customer environment variables for at most 1.85% of workspaces (about 100,000) were accessed, a maximum estimate rather than confirmed thefts. Railway believes the attackers wanted AI provider keys for resale and told customers on Oct. 22 to rotate secrets.
highlights: Up to 100,000 workspaces' env vars accessed (max estimate)
Motive believed to be AI key resale
